data.text: I'm just blown away by this. Fable 5.2 w/standard harness achieves as high as 80% on ARC-AGI-3 and nearly 100% w/harness-saving-state on a benchmark released in April of this year, which most models fail to break 5%. https://t.co/LVXQ3gxcAA https://t.co/0nXOG1fmxm

Claude Fable 5.2 (81.2%) is the first model to beat Astra Max  (62.7%) with both sporting just a standard harness. Those are the only two models to surpass 60% on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark (that rates LLMs in novel environments) in such a setting. https://t.co/gHY5uINrR8
